result.title: Contestable Agents for Data Governance: Recording Human Stewardship of AI-Generated Metadata Across Structured and Unstructured Systems
result.summary: Industrial organizations hold operational knowledge in structured records, such as telemetry, point lists, and transactions, and in unstructured sources, such as manuals, service notes, communications, and inspection reports. Governance programs often manage these sources separately. Classifying, linking, and documenting them depends on a small group of employees with deep domain knowledge. Agents built on large language models can propose metadata, cite documents, and flag quality issues, but unreviewed proposals can spread errors into downstream systems. A perfunctory approval leaves no record of what a reviewer checked. We present contestable governance: specialist agents produce scored, cited arguments for disputed metadata decisions; a steward can accept, reject, modify, or add arguments before commit; and a governance record retains the evidence, interventions, and outcome. A versioned domain glossary supplies model-specific terms and acronym definitions to the agents. We describe the workflow, a triage path that reserves full argumentation for uncertain proposals while preserving review before commit, the scoring and record models, and a gate that controls which verified decisions become precedent. Two HVAC use cases illustrate the pattern: point classification using Brick Schema class labels, supported by an open reference implementation, and an illustrative warranty failure-mode decision linking claim fields and telemetry to service notes and revisioned bulletins.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「可争议治理」工作流：专用 LLM agent 为有争议的元数据决策生成带评分的引用论证，人类 steward 可接受、拒绝、修改或补充后方可提交，系统记录证据、干预与结果，并仅对不确定提案启用完整论证、用门控决定哪些已核验决策成为先例；以两个 HVAC 用例说明。
AI.relevance_reason: 不确定性触发的 triage（仅在可疑提案上花费论证成本）可为核查 LVR 中动态计算与停止决策提供类比，其证据与人工干预记录或可启发视觉证据筛选及贡献分配的监督设计，但属远领域概念迁移，需核查其评分与门控机制的具体形式。
